ideas.name: potM1 with a 5m row warning too
ideas.why: the 1m MACD easing while a 5m row eases the same way is a slowdown on two horizons

ideas.name: potM1 in a strong trend (big histogram)
ideas.why: easing from a big histogram (half an ATR or more) is a strong move running out, where reversals are larger

ideas.name: potE1 with a stretched EMA gap
ideas.why: the 12/26 gap over 1.5 ATR is a stretched trend; easing there snaps back further

ideas.name: potM1 with the 5m box already turned its way
ideas.why: if both 5m rows already point the warned way, the 1m warning is the last timeframe to catch up
